_comment: Growth-only corpus manifest for the schema-migration archaeology lane (umbrella #842 W1.5). `ladderLength` MUST equal packages/vault/src/schema/migrate.ts VAULT_MIGRATIONS.length, and `epochs` MUST be the contiguous 1..ladderLength. Adding a migration rung means bumping `ladderLength`, appending the new epoch here, and (if the seed changes) updating `expectedCensus` — that is how 'any PR touching migrations migrates every corpus member' is enforced. Never remove an epoch. `authority` and `reach` count CONCEPTS, not tables: #883 rung six moved authority answers from share_grant to share_authority and rung seven moved reachability from core_party_identifier to social_contact_channel, so the corpus seeds both in the rung-one shape and lets the rungs themselves fold them.
